name: The Order of the Horned Star
tagline: A candlelit lodge under an old city, and a horned idol with a star on its brow.
era: An invented city, in no particular year
summary: Raise the order's illumination to 100 while keeping loyalty at 50 or more. Refuse the inner lodge if it demands a forbidden rite.
action.send_invitation.desc: Slip a sealed card to a curious guest. Adds followers and a little scrutiny; new faces ease paranoia.
action.read_the_stars.desc: Cast horoscopes for paying patrons. Adds funds and a little illumination.
action.kneel_to_idol.desc: Kneel before the Horned One by candlelight. Raises illumination and loyalty and hides the lodge from outsiders, but feeds the zealots' paranoia.
codex.fall.unmasked: The newspapers printed the lodge's address and the members' names, and the order broke apart. (Game ending.)
